description: Training history between two dates, newest first: date, local start, name, type, miles, pace, time, elevation, average heart rate, and on a runs-only list Friel's efficiency factor and the heartbeats each mile took. Start here for totals, streaks, trends, or finding a run. For one run's splits, use ourpr_get_run with an id from here.

end_date.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2026-06-30

include_non_runs.description: Include rides, gym and other types. Runs only by default.

limit.description: Most rows to return. The answer says what it left out.

start_date.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2026-01-01

name: ourpr_list_runs
title: List runs in a date range
